last.verdict: Earnings beat Nucor's own forecast and the outlook held up, so shares rose.

reasons.label: Beat own forecast
reasons.text: Earnings of $5.80 per share topped the $5.55-$5.65 range Nucor gave in September.

reasons.label: Higher steel prices
reasons.text: Average selling price rose 9% from last quarter to $1,493 per ton, lifting profit.

reasons.label: Steady outlook
reasons.text: Management expects fourth-quarter earnings flat to modestly higher, despite fewer shipping days and planned outages.

story: Nucor's profit has climbed sharply this year, from $2.63 per share a year ago to $5.80 now, helped by higher steel prices and record shipments. Q2 also beat guidance, partly from a $130 million raw-material cost refund that did not repeat.
